instruction: Set VLC's recording folder to the Desktop directory.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully navigated VLC advanced preferences (Tools > Preferences > All > Interface > Main interfaces > Qt) to disable the background cone icon, saved settings, and restarted VLC to verify the change.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate VLC advanced preferences, find specific settings, toggle checkboxes, save preferences, restart VLC
metadata.task_rationale: Related VLC config task: changing the recording folder requires navigating VLC preferences (Input/Codecs section) similar to the original Qt preferences task, testing the same preference navigation capability in a different settings area.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VLC's recording folder to Desktop via preferences. Evaluator uses existing get_vlc_config getter to read vlcrc file, and is_vlc_recordings_folder metric to verify input-record-path is set to /home/user/Desktop.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter get_vlc_config correctly reads the vlcrc configuration file from the VM, which contains the recording path setting.
Metric is_vlc_recordings_folder correctly parses vlcrc for 'input-record-path' and compares it to the expected '/home/user/Desktop' value.
Expected parameter handling is correct: with type='rule', get_rule returns {'recording_file_path': '/home/user/Desktop'}, and the metric accesses rule['recording_file_path'] directly.
Postconfig correctly kills VLC before reading config, ensuring vlcrc is flushed to disk with the latest settings.
Expected value '/home/user/Desktop' is the correct standard Linux Desktop directory path.
Full instruction coverage: the single requirement (set recording folder to Desktop) is fully verified by the evaluator.
